resources.string: Global defaults; assistants can inherit or use their own cards.
Assistant: %1$s. These settings apply only to this assistant.

Normal mode shows work and everyday starters; entertainment mode shows character and story starters. Pinned cards appear first, up to the display limit. Long-press a card in chat to pin it for that assistant.
No cards for this mode. Enable built-in cards or add your own.
Use {{topic}} or {{place}} for fields to fill before inserting. {{char_name}} and {{user_name}} use the current assistant and user names. Up to 12 variables.
Too many variables. Reduce the number to 12 or fewer.
Could not save. Try again; the previous configuration is unchanged.
Inserts into the composer without sending. Existing attachments are kept.
A draft already exists. Choose append or replace.
The draft changed. Your latest text was kept. Please confirm again.
Reuse code-block surface, outline and corners over the shared backdrop. Turn off to customize.
Applies when a backdrop is present; otherwise uses the theme surface.
Set to 0 to hide the outline.
As {{char_name}}, start a dialogue about {{topic}}. Follow the active character setting without deciding my actions or replies.
Describe a scene in {{place}} for {{char_name}} to enter. Follow the active world setting, leave unknown details open, and leave room for my response.
Offer three story openings around {{story_theme}} that fit the active world setting. Let me choose without advancing the story for me.
Help develop {{character_detail}} for {{char_name}}. Distinguish established details from proposals, without rewriting existing worldbook facts.
Create an encounter for {{char_name}} at {{place}}. Open with room for me to respond, without deciding my actions.
Start a relaxed everyday scene about {{activity}}, preserving the character of {{char_name}} and the current world setting.
